summary: Regression-tested public backend APIs, lockout behavior, and mobile UI loading/navigation.
action_items: No app fixes required from exercised flows. For future mobile E2E, reopen the hamburger menu before selecting another sidebar route.

success_rate.frontend: 75% of attempted scripted steps; registration, mobile overflow, and Explore navigation passed; continuation was blocked by hidden mobile menu

seed_data_creation: Created temporary TEST_ registration and one temporary lockout email through public APIs; created one completed session in the existing regression test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public preview tested. Backend auth/starter ownership, logout, Google 501 setup response, generic forgot-password response, session pause/resume/finish, and dashboard stats passed. Mobile registration, no horizontal overflow, and Explore navigation passed. Google OAuth and password-reset email delivery remain MOCKED/credential-gated by design. Browser script stopped when it tried to click a hidden sidebar link after the menu had closed; this is a test-flow limitation, not a reproduced product bug.
rca of the issue: The browser continuation failure occurred because selecting Explore invokes setMobileNav(false), so nav-home is intentionally offscreen until mobile-menu-button is clicked again. No product defect was reproduced.
